{{Quote|Shame to have lost Peden over a pack of droids, though - he had a good head on his shoulders. Would've been good to have him moving forward.|Durand|<ref name="A Mysterious Enemy" />}}
'''Durand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where an Imperial hero informed him that [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Peden]] and his squad were wiped out by the Republic spy [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
